title: mermicorn.repo.yaml
description: Schema for mermicorn.repo.yaml — the canonical per-repo metadata file in the Mermicorn constellation. Every repository must contain a file at the root named mermicorn.repo.yaml that satisfies this schema.

id.description: Repository slug (matches GitHub repo name exactly).

owner.description: Responsible owner. 'cherry' = Cherry owns domain judgment. 'mermicorn' = shared constellation service.

lane.description: Functional lane. identity-governance=Grove+profile. ai-core=shared AI services. commerce=commerce verticals. gaming=gaming/community. career=operator apprenticeship. private-ops=internal only.

status.description: Lifecycle status. foundation=structure only. building=active construction. first-proof=proof artifact in progress. active=shipping. stable=maintained. archived=retired. planned=not started.

problem.description: The specific problem this repo solves.

first_proof.description: The first publishable artifact this repo will produce.

artifact.description: Short name or description of the artifact.

shared_services.description: Shared constellation services this repo consumes.

privacy.description: What data lives in public vs private surfaces of this repo.
